title: Into the Shaker, Along with Ice

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
upon hearing a rumor that Tanino Gimlet
would be running in a mock race,
I decided to go watch.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Broad daylight.
Ah, a fleeting breeze caresses my cheek!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What a fitting day!
Engrave it into the heavens,
into the earth,
and into those eyes of yours!
My primal impulse!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet might seem eccentric,
but word is her skills are legit.
I heard she even helped turn a club team
around in the past or something.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Huh! She still doesn't have a dedicated
Trainer, right?
I bet a lot of Trainers have their eyes on
her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eccentric though she may be,
it seems her racing abilities command genuine
respect.
—Just then, the mock race begins!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And they're off for 1,600 meters on the
turf!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet settles into the back of the
pack,
—and holds that position as they approach
the fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner into the
homestretch!
She's still boxed inside the pack,
completely boxed in!
Tanino Gimlet is trailing behind!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...This looks bad for Tanino Gimlet.
The runners around her have formed a wall,
she can't break out.
If only she could find an opening...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(A warrior's labyrinth, is it?!
The thread of Ariadne I must follow has—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Snapped.
—Hmph...! Fascinating!
Then with this body alone,
I shall cut my own path through!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
100 meters to go,
and Tanino Gimlet finally charges up from
behind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having broken free,
Tanino Gimlet accelerated with a furious
roar. Closing the gap with immense speed,
she reached the lead pack in an instant,
but—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—What a monstrous final burst!
Tanino Gimlet takes 3rd place!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She couldn't quite reach the leader after all.
That must sting...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: *Pant, pant*...! Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Is the summit of Elbrus still beyond my
reach...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had undeniably let victory slip away.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That closing kick to claw her way to 3rd in
just the last 100 meters...!
If she hadn't been blocked,
she would have secured an effortless
victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have an exclusive Trainer yet,
meaning that display
wasn't the result of fine-tuning,
but her own raw, god-given talent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With speed like that,
if she pushed down the Mile track,
she'd undoubtedly achieve monumental
success...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overcome with excitement,
I dashed out of the stands
and ran onto the turf to scout her. But—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“You possess extraordinary talent.
With that terrifying speed,
you could achieve marvelous things on the
Mile circuit.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“You possess extraordinary talent.
With that terrifying speed,
you could achieve marvelous things on the
Mile circuit.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I have received your words.
You have faith in my talent,
meaning you have cleared the first
barrier.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, that is merely the first barrier.
...Look. How many fingers do you see?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She abruptly held up a single finger.
Completely baffled,
I answered honestly for now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Two.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You narrow your vision down to a singular
possibility.
You are still... lacking.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then there is only one thing left to do.
I shall impart a twist unto you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And through that,
we shall ascertain—both you and I.
Whether Utopia truly lies beyond the horizon
of this boundless ocean.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That alone is our destination.
For we cannot allow this to end as the
Asphodel Meadows.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—First, I entrust you with this.
Follow the inscription to trace the past,
and discern the future...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to my dorm and opening the
letter she had handed me—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Dost thou seek the tale of Tanino Gimlet?
The eternal saga that has flowed unbroken
since that fateful childhood day—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It appeared to be a memoir recounting
the story of Tanino Gimlet's life.
